Prospective, nonclinical research proposals. Only offline simulations, synthetic records, inert phantoms and legally authorized existing nonclinical archives are considered. No new live-cell procedures, human or animal interventions, stimulation, implants or autonomous deployment are prescribed. No therapeutic efficacy, functional recovery or quantum advantage is established.
